description: Low-friction batch restricted-party screen for up to 25 counterparties in one paid call. Returns per-name screening results, flagged counterparties, a batch-level proceed-or-pause recommendation, and machine-readable review signals for procurement, payouts, and cross-border onboarding workflows. Required query param: names separated with the pipe character (|). Optional query params: workflow, minScore, type, country, program, list, limit.
